title: Subtraction on encoded binary inputs
statement: For any natural numbers $a$ and $b$, encode their binary expansions as a pair by doubling every bit of the first expansion, appending the separator $01$, and then the second expansion. Apply the decoded subtraction operation to this encoded string. The result is the binary expansion of $a-b$, where subtraction on natural numbers is truncated at zero.
